text:
- United Kingdom generated £94.1k revenue in TW, representing 75.6% of total sales across all countries.
- Australia achieved £16.7k revenue in TW with a WoW increase of 3954.5% and a YoY increase of 4139.0%.
- Finland delivered £4.4k revenue in TW, up 2575.0% WoW, and now holds a 3.6% share of total revenue.
- Total revenue reached £124.4k in TW, up 2.6% WoW but down 21.5% YoY compared to the same week last year.
- United Kingdom processed 250 orders in TW, significantly higher than France with 9 orders and EIRE with 3 orders.
- Total units sold were 67309 in TW, a slight decrease from 68040 units in LW.
- Belgium revenue grew 179.4% WoW and 56.4% YoY, demonstrating strong momentum in this market.
- France revenue declined 8.7% YoY despite maintaining order activity in TW.
